description: This file defines a console command class 'AddRolePermissionCommand' that allows adding permissions for user roles to data groups within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for configuring the command, interacting with user input, executing the permission addition, and generating SQL snippets for the changes.

classes.name: AddRolePermissionCommand
classes.description: A command class extending Symfony's Command to facilitate adding permissions for user roles to data groups, including interaction, validation, and SQL generation functionalities.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command's description, arguments, and options.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the SymfonyStyle object for interaction.

methods.name: interact
methods.description: Engages the user to input the data group name and user role, providing autocompletion and validation.

methods.name: getDataGroupAutocompleteQuestion
methods.description: Constructs a Question object with autocomplete for selecting a data group.

methods.name: getUserRoleAutocompleteQuestion
methods.description: Constructs a Question object with autocomplete for selecting a user role.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the main logic of creating and optionally persisting a DataGroupPermission based on user input.

methods.name: printDataGroupPermissionTable
methods.description: Displays existing permissions for a data group in a table.

methods.name: printDataGroupPermissionSQL
methods.description: Generates and displays sample SQL queries for the permission settings.

methods.name: printBlock
methods.description: Outputs a formatted block of SQL or message text.
